name: Bitter Triumph
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or pay 3 life.
Destroy target creature or planeswalker.
blocked_sentences: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or pay 3 life.

needs.what: a cost that is a choice between two whole alternative payments -- 'discard a card OR pay 3 life' -- where the caster picks one branch as the spell is cast and only that branch is paid and checked for payability
needs.why_existing_wont_do: A cost is a single flat record whose entries are conjunctive: writing both `discard` and `pay_life` on the same cost charges the player both, which is a strictly worse card, and writing only one silently drops the other half of the printed line. `additional_optional` is the nearest thing and only makes one fixed cost skippable (a yes/no on paying it), not a choice between two different prices; `choose_mode` is an effect op that runs on resolution, so it can neither be a cost nor gate whether the spell is castable
